limitations: Exact historical verdict and stated assumptions only; migration makes no new scientific inference.

legacy.claim: Adding swirl to the scarcity field reproduces frame dragging
legacy.evidence: [frame-drag-swirl](../../../orrery/lab/sims/frame-drag-swirl/) supplies the prior positive verdict: the toy has the right qualitative swirl shape. [Moving-source gravity bounds](../../studies/moving-source-gravity-bounds.md) now sources the nature target — GP-B measured the frame-dragging drift at 19%, while LAGEOS/LARES agree with GR at claimed few-percent to disputed ~19% precision; a completion must reproduce the Lense–Thirring magnitude, 1/r³ falloff, and spin-source character. The row remains mixed because the toy has not been compared with those quantitative targets
